body.x: KIMST (CEO Jungmin Kim) participated in the 2024 Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX 2024), held at EXCO from October 23 (Wednesday) to October 26 (Saturday).

KIMST, known for its electric scooter brand of the same name, has rapidly grown in South Korea’s e-mobility market. Since its establishment in May 2020, the company has been leading the push for eco-friendly mobility, contributing to reducing air pollution risks domestically. It also lays the groundwork for entry into the Southeast Asian market, where motorcycles are highly favored, striving to secure global competitiveness.
At the exhibition, KIMST showcased its flagship product, the “DICE” series, which has gained popularity in South Korea’s two-wheeler market since its launch.

The highlight was the DICE SUPER, a strongly performing model in the sub-4.5kW electric two-wheeler segment. With enhanced battery capacity and performance, it offers a driving range of up to 90 km on a full charge. It supports a maximum load of 235 kg, making it ideal for urban short-distance commutes and delivery services.

Additionally, KIMST introduced a range of models, including the DICE PLUS, an electric tricycle with a stable three-wheel structure, and the DICE-Truck, a multipurpose electric cargo scooter. The company emphasizes the improved fire safety of Samsung SDI battery cells in all models.

body.cap: KIMST’s booth at FIX 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A company representative stated, “Our advanced technology has enabled us to secure the maximum subsidy for eco-friendly motorcycles from the Ministry of Environment. This achievement has helped KIMST become the top brand in personal electric scooters in terms of consumer recognition this year. We are here to show our gratitude for the support and connect with potential customers interested in eco-friendly mobility.”

The representative added, “As the small electric mobility market moves past its infancy and enters a transitional phase, no industry leader has emerged. KIMST aims to lead this field by proactively entering overseas markets. We have established close cooperation with Vietnam’s mobility associations and leading brands, and we are expanding our product lineup through ongoing research and development to stay ahead.”

FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
